fields.name: Child's Pose
fields.instuctions: Kneel on the mat and lower your hips toward your heels while extending your arms forward. Rest your forehead gently on the floor.
fields.benifits: Relaxes the lumbar spine and reduces lower back tension safely.

fields.name: Supine Neck Release
fields.instuctions: Lie on your back and slowly rotate your head side to side within a comfortable range. Keep your shoulders relaxed throughout
fields.benifits: Decreases neck stiffness and improves gentle cervical mobility.

fields.name: Big - Toe pose
fields.instuctions: Lie flat and raise one leg upward using a strap if needed. Keep the opposite leg extended and relaxed.
fields.benifits: Stretches hamstrings and reduces strain around the knee joint.

fields.name: SupportedBridge Pose
fields.instuctions: Lie on your back and place a yoga block under your hips for support. Keep your knees aligned with your feet.
fields.benifits: Supports spinal alignment and gently activates glute muscles.

fields.name: Cat-Cow Pose
fields.instuctions: Move slowly between arching and rounding your spine on hands and knees. Coordinate each movement with your breath.
fields.benifits: Improves spinal flexibility and reduces back stiffness.

fields.name: Seated Neck Stretch
fields.instuctions: Sit upright and gently tilt your head toward one shoulder. Repeat slowly on both sides without forcing the stretch.
fields.benifits: Releases tension in the neck and upper trapezius muscles.

fields.name: Standing Quad Stretch
fields.instuctions: Stand tall and pull one foot toward your hips while holding support if needed. Keep both knees close together.
fields.benifits: Loosens tight thigh muscles and improves knee flexibility.

fields.name: Sphinx Pose
fields.instuctions: Lie on your stomach and support your upper body on your forearms. Keep your lower back relaxed and shoulders down.
fields.benifits: Provides mild spinal extension without excessive lumbar pressure.

fields.name: Thread the Needle Pose
fields.instuctions: From hands and knees, slide one arm under the opposite arm and rest your shoulder on the mat. Keep your breathing steady
fields.benifits: Reduces tightness in the neck, shoulders, and upper back.

fields.name: Heel Slides
fields.instuctions: Lie on your back and slowly slide one heel toward your hips and back out again. Move within a pain-free range.
fields.benifits: Improves knee mobility and supports gentle joint rehabilitation

fields.name: Cobra Pose
fields.instuctions: Lie face down and lift your chest slightly using light pressure from your hands. Keep your elbows soft and shoulders relaxed.
fields.benifits: Strengthens spinal muscles and improves posture support.

fields.name: Chin Tuck Pose
fields.instuctions: Sit or stand upright and gently draw your chin backward without tilting the head. Hold briefly and release slowly.
fields.benifits: Strengthens deep neck muscles and improves cervical alignment.

fields.name: Chair Pose
fields.instuctions: Bend your knees slightly as if sitting into a chair while keeping your chest lifted. Use a wall for support if needed.
fields.benifits: Strengthens quadriceps and improves knee stability.

fields.name: Easy Seated Twist
fields.instuctions: Sit comfortably and rotate your torso gently to one side while keeping your spine tall. Repeat on both sides.
fields.benifits: Improves spinal rotation and relieves back tightness.

fields.name: Cow Face Arms Pose
fields.instuctions: Reach one arm overhead and the other behind your back to clasp hands or a strap. Keep your chest open.
fields.benifits: Improves shoulder mobility and reduces upper neck tension.

fields.name: Triangle Pose
fields.instuctions: Stand with feet wide apart and reach one hand toward your shin while extending the opposite arm upward. Keep both legs straight but relaxed.
fields.benifits: Enhances leg flexibility and improves lower body balance.

fields.name: Bridge Pose
fields.instuctions: Press into your feet and slowly lift your hips from the floor. Keep your thighs parallel during the lift.
fields.benifits: Strengthens the lower back and gluteal muscles safely.

fields.name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
fields.instuctions: Sit upright and turn your head slightly before lowering your chin toward your chest. Apply gentle pressure with your hand if comfortable
fields.benifits: Targets deep neck tension and improves cervical flexibility.

fields.name: Warrior I Pose
fields.instuctions: Step one foot forward into a lunge and raise your arms overhead. Keep the front knee aligned above the ankle.
fields.benifits: Builds strength in the legs and supports knee alignment.

fields.name: Downward Facing Dog
fields.instuctions: Lift your hips upward into an inverted V shape while pressing through your hands. Keep your knees slightly bent if needed
fields.benifits: Lengthens the spine and stretches back muscles effectively.

fields.name: Fish Pose
fields.instuctions: Lie on your back and gently lift your chest while supporting yourself on your elbows. Avoid placing heavy pressure on the head.
fields.benifits: Opens the chest and improves upper spine posture.

fields.name: Warrior II Pose
fields.instuctions: Step into a wide stance and bend the front knee while extending your arms outward. Keep your torso upright and stable.
fields.benifits: Strengthens quadriceps and hip stabilizers for knee support.

fields.name: Locust Pose
fields.instuctions: Wrap one arm under the other and bring your palms together if possible. Lift the elbows slightly while relaxing the shoulders.
fields.benifits: Relieves upper back -and neck tightness caused by poor posture.

fields.name: Eagle Arms Stretch
fields.instuctions: Wrap one arm under the other and bring your palms together if possible. Lift the elbows slightly while relaxing the shoulders.
fields.benifits: Relieves upper back and neck tightness caused by poor posture.

fields.name: Garland Pose
fields.instuctions: Lower into a gentle squat while keeping your heels supported if necessary. Bring your palms together at chest level.
fields.benifits: Improves ankle and knee mobility with controlled loading.

fields.name: Upward Facing Dog
fields.instuctions: Press into your palms and lift your chest while keeping your thighs off the floor. Avoid forcing the lower back into deep compression.
fields.benifits: Strengthens spinal extensors and improves posture control.

fields.name: Extended Side Angle Pose
fields.instuctions: Bend one knee deeply and extend one arm overhead alongside your ear. Keep the chest open and legs engaged.
fields.benifits: Builds lower body strength and improves joint stability.

fields.name: Camel Pose
fields.instuctions: Kneel upright and gently arch backward while supporting your lower back with your hands if needed. Keep the movement controlled.
fields.benifits: Stretches the front body and improves spinal flexibility gradually.

fields.name: Half Lord of the Fishes Pose
fields.instuctions: Sit upright and rotate your torso deeply to one side while maintaining a long spine. Repeat carefully on both sides
fields.benifits: Enhances spinal and cervical mobility with controlled rotation.

fields.name: Supported Pigeon Pose
fields.instuctions: From a forward lunge position, place support under the bent leg and lower your hips gently. Keep the stretch comfortable.
fields.benifits: Improves hip flexibility and reduces compensatory knee tension.
